prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1281; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather keep my name off the recording for now, if that's okay. You can use the claim number.

Q: That works. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through the intersection at a major road in Pasadena, Texas. I had a green light, I'm pretty sure of that.

Q: Which direction were you traveling?

A: I was heading straight through, going east.

Q: What happened next?

A: A vehicle coming from the cross street ran the red and hit the driver's side of my car. The impact spun me a little and pushed me toward the curb.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Only for a second. It came out of nowhere, honestly. I hit the brakes, but there wasn't time.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: How are you feeling physically since the accident?

A: My right shoulder is pretty bad. I hit the door when the car was hit, and the shoulder took the brunt of it. I can't lift my arm above my head without sharp pain.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment?

A: I was taken to the emergency room by ambulance that afternoon. They took X-rays and said there was no fracture, but I've been referred to an orthopedic specialist and I start physical therapy next week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Just that I'm cooperating fully and I want this handled fairly. I have photos of the vehicles and the intersection on my phone, and I can send them to you.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
